explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified VAI 249 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: Pantoprazole sodium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2019-05-28 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a span of 89 months.
FDA inspection 1066512 at Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189) ended 2018-09-21 with a VAI classification, 249 days before the shortage posting on 2019-05-28.
The same plant was most recently inspected in 2023-06-16 and again classified VAI.

Another labeled supplier, Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407), received an OAI classification in 2009-06-11 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08, but its later inspections have been VAI, most recently 2026-07-16.
Hospital inventory shows 13.6 to 22.1 days on hand across sites and presentations.
Per the decision rule, the recommended check is to buy from Avenacy, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
